observations.finding: Oracle POST is intentionally called by normal consumer trade UI, on mount and every 60000 ms; no request authentication in source route.
observations.permission: Provider server owns configured administrator signer. Agent did not invoke this POST or access/use the credential.

observations.finding: GET oracle merely returns public Yahoo reference quotes; POST fetches them and invokes configured vault set_prices using provider signer.
observations.permission: Caller cannot provide prices/vault/key in request body; configuration is server-side. Nonetheless external integration requires lead review.

observations.finding: The score API computes public account activity heuristic, no KYC/credit/collateral proof. Account-age heuristic uses hardcoded current ledger 55000000, mismatching actual observed Testnet ledger5681203.
observations.permission: Do not manufacture identity or claim this score is verified credit/KYC.

observations.finding: Circuit constrains supplied private score range0-100 and derives tier, but contains no oracle signature or verifiable commitment to Horizon account data.
observations.permission: Proof validity establishes circuit computation, not truth/provenance of account credit score.

observations.finding: Verifier source declares SIG_WALLET_ADDRESS but verification routine does not compare it to wallet argument. No wallet.require_auth in verify_and_register.
observations.permission: Customer-bound session/intent checks cannot be delegated to this verifier.

observations.finding: Frontend derives wallet_secret from SHA256(public address + week) without actual signMessage/signTransaction call. On verification errors it marks local tier verified through localStorage fallback.
observations.permission: Do not copy these fallback paths or count local storage as onchain tier proof.
